visual.general_description: Five axial brain MRI slices of different contrasts with enlarged ventricles and white arrows.
visual.detailed_description: A single-row composite of five grayscale axial brain MRI slices without panel letters. White arrows mark the posterior midline at the back of the lateral ventricles in four slices. The caption dates the examination to September 18 and lists T2, FLAIR, DWI and enhanced examination findings.

panels.general_description: Row of five grayscale axial brain MRI slices with enlarged lateral ventricles; four carry a white arrow.
panels.detailed_description: Five axial brain MRI slices are placed side by side without panel letters. Each slice is a different grayscale contrast: one has a dark fluid-filled ventricular system on a mid-gray brain, one shows the ventricles as bright fluid against darker brain tissue, one shows dark ventricles with a gray brain, one is dark overall with faint brain outline, and the rightmost shows dark ventricles with bright small vessel-like dots. The ventricles look enlarged and butterfly-shaped in all five. A white arrow points toward the posterior midline at the back of the lateral ventricles in the first four slices. The fifth slice carries a very small white arrow-like mark in the posterior midline. No printed text, scale bar or label is visible.

visual.general_description: Uncaptioned cartoon flow graphic with brain images, medication images, an inner ear illustration and printed phrases.
visual.detailed_description: Schematic graphic with printed phrases about repeated headaches, repeated diagnosis of bacterial meningitis, an unclear cause, an inner ear illustration and headache improvement after surgery.

panels.general_description: Uncaptioned cartoon flow graphic with brain images, medication images, an inner ear illustration, arrows and short printed phrases.
panels.detailed_description: Uncaptioned schematic graphic. At upper left a grayscale brain image with white dots sits above the printed text "Repeatedly headache cause?". A yellow-orange arrow runs to the right under the printed text "Repeated visits to the hospital and doctors diagnosed Bacterial meningitis, but the cause was unclear". A second brain image with white dots follows, with an image of a gray tablet and an orange-brown capsule with spilling granules above it. Near it the printed text reads "Not paying attention to the improvement of drug treatment for many times". A curved yellow arrow leads down to a coloured anatomical illustration of the inner ear in red, blue and beige tones, next to the printed text "Where is the origin of the disease?". Below the ear the printed text reads "After careful examination, it was found that the cause of headache was inner ear malformation". A long orange-pink arrow points left along the bottom to the printed text "After surgical treatment, the patient's headache improved significantly".

evidence.quote: After consulting the otorhinolaryngology department

pixel_observations: Cartoon-style flow of brain images, a tablet and capsule image and an inner ear illustration joined by arrows.
Printed phrases transcribed in the detailed description; the question marks belong to the printed text.
limitations: Printed text is pixel content only; no facts are taken from it.
The graphic is uncaptioned and low resolution; arrow endpoints are not mapped as relations.
Uncaptioned; the graphic sits in the abstract position without a caption.
